Jethalal arrives at his shop to find an unfamiliar young man trying to sell him goods. He discovers it's Bagha—Nattu Kaka's nephew—who has been left in charge while Nattu Kaka attends a family religious function in his village.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
